title: 第13章 我是碰巧路过的你信吗第14章 好奇心
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
即使是身为天辉城的一流大家族，对于这件事情依然很无奈。
不过还好，地苍龙怎么也是成长率稀有的灵宠，最高能够达到七阶十级。
以目前天辉城的现状来说，霍青山暂时还能够压得住。
毕竟，霍青山本身现在也才六阶九级，想要变强到七阶十级，还有一段不短的路要走。
而霍仙儿，年纪轻轻，才获得地苍龙不到一年时间，便已经达到一阶七级。
虽然在整个联邦之中，这算不得什么。
但是在天辉城，绝对算得上是首屈一指的天才之列。
之前的叶凌，获得僵尸灵宠，也差不多花了大半年时间，才堪堪达到一阶二级。
当然，这也和血幽之前的行动力有很大关系。
就算是正常的普通学生，也差不多有一阶三四级的实力。
从这就能看出，霍仙儿是真的天才。
逐渐深入葬骨丘的叶凌，自然也听到了前面传来的战斗声音。
第一时间赶过来，刚好看到，地苍龙轻松解决掉骷髅军士。
骷髅军士，要比骷髅兵强上一些，一般来说，实力最差也在一阶五级。
不过以目前血幽一阶三级的实力，想要战胜骷髅军士，难度也不会太大。
这是因为，血幽本身力量和防御力强大，又具有不错的天赋技能。
不然，还真不一定能应付骷髅军士。
但是，就算血幽能对付骷髅军士，也绝对没有地苍龙这么轻松。
这只地苍龙，实力至少也在一阶七级左右。
因此以目前血幽的实力，不用想了，暂时还不是对方的对手。

正在和地苍龙交流的霍仙儿，突然眼神一凝，似乎感觉到了什么。
“躲躲藏藏的想干什么，出来吧。”
清冷的声音响起。
听到声音，叶凌就知道，自己看来是被发现了。
不过，本来叶凌就没打算隐藏自己。
大大方方的走了出来，虽然血幽的实力，现在还比不上地苍龙，但是逃跑却没有多大的问题。
这里毕竟是属于魔物纵横的地带，如果对方对自己有不好的目的，叶凌完全可以驱狼吞虎。
在看到霍仙儿正脸的时候，叶凌他是忍不住微微一怔。
虽然霍仙儿是霍家的人，但是依然在高校里面读书。
并且还是叶凌学校的校花，同时也是实力非常靠前的尖子生。
也是现在学校之中，呼声最高，能够进入到顶级御灵使学院的候选人之一。
在学校之中，现在获得灵宠的人，全部都是些高三学生，大体的年龄都在十八岁以上，接近十九岁左右。
差不多都获得了接近半年多的灵宠。
而其中，将灵宠培育的非常好，实力非常强大的，大部分都是那些家族子弟。
毕竟家族里面最不缺的就是资源，同时，即使是外出历练，说不定也会有人跟着陪同。
content_en:
Even as a first-class big family in Tianhui City, they are still helpless about this matter.
Fortunately, Di Canglong is also a spiritual pet with a rare growth rate, and can reach the highest level seven and ten.
Judging from the current situation of Tianhui City, Huo Qingshan can still suppress it for the time being.
After all, Huo Qingshan himself is only at level 6 and level 9. If he wants to become stronger than level 7 and level 10, he still has a long way to go.
And Huo Xian'er, at a young age, had already reached the first and seventh level in less than a year after acquiring the Earth Canglong.
Although in the entire federation, this is nothing.
But in Tianhui City, he is definitely one of the top geniuses.
It took Ye Ling almost half a year to get a zombie spiritual pet before he could reach the first level and the second level.
Of course, this also has a lot to do with Xueyou's previous mobility.
Even normal ordinary students are almost at level 1, level 3 or level 4 strength.
From this we can see that Huo Xianer is a real genius.
Ye Ling, who gradually went deeper into the Bone Burial Mound, naturally heard the sounds of fighting coming from ahead.
I rushed over immediately and happened to see Di Canglong easily dispatching the skeleton sergeant.
Skeleton sergeants are stronger than skeleton soldiers. Generally speaking, the weakest ones are at level one and five.
However, with Xueyou's current level one and three strength, it won't be too difficult to defeat Skeleton Sergeant.
This is because Xueyou itself has strong strength and defense, as well as good talents and skills.
Otherwise, he might not be able to deal with the Skeleton Sergeant.
However, even if Xueyou can deal with the skeleton sergeant, it will never be as easy as Di Canglong.
This Earth Cang Dragon's strength is at least around level one and seven.
Therefore, with Xueyou's current strength, there is no need to think about it. He is not a match for the opponent yet.
Huo Xianer, who was communicating with Di Canglong, suddenly focused his eyes and seemed to feel something.
"What do you want to do in hiding? Come out."
A cool voice sounded.
Hearing the sound, Ye Ling knew that he seemed to have been discovered.
However, Ye Ling had no intention of hiding himself.
He walked out openly. Although Xueyou's strength was still not as good as Di Canglong's, there was no big problem in escaping.
After all, this is an area where monsters roam freely. If the opponent has bad intentions for him, Ye Ling can drive away the wolf and devour the tiger.
When he saw Huo Xianer's face, Ye Ling couldn't help but be slightly startled.
Although Huo Xianer is from the Huo family, she is still studying in college.
She is also the school beauty of Ye Ling School and a very top student.
He is also one of the most popular candidates in the school to enter the top spiritual envoy academy.
In the school, the people who are currently receiving spiritual pets are all senior high school students, and they are generally over 18 years old, close to 19 years old.
Almost all of them have obtained spiritual pets for more than half a year.
Among them, most of those who have cultivated spiritual pets very well and are very powerful are the children of those families.
After all, the most indispensable thing in the family is resources. At the same time, even if you go out for training, someone might accompany you.
